text.content: m7 Lesson C
unit
People on my mind
A Write the name of someone you know for each description. Then think about answers
to the questions.
z
Someone | miss very much: Someone who gave me a special gift:
What was the gift?
@ How long have you known this person? @ What was the gift?
How long have you had it?
@ When did you last see him or her? @ How long have you had it?
What made the gift special?
@ When will you see each other again? @ What made the gift special?
Someone I’d like to know better: Someone I’ve admired since | was a child:
When did you first meet this person?
@ How long have you known this person? @ When did you first meet this person?
What do you admire about him or her?
When was the last time you spoke?
What's he or she like?
@ What’s he or she like? @ Doyou share any of the same qualities?
B Interview your partner about each person. Ask questions for more information.
A: Who is someone you miss very much?
B: I miss my grandmother very much.
A: How long have you known her?
B: I've known her since I was born! But I haven't seen her since April.
Keep talking!
